details: The Innovex IAS014LI is a portable party speaker designed for strong sound and easy mobility. It delivers 130W RMS power with dual 8-inch woofers and dual 3-inch tweeters. Connect via Bluetooth 5.3, USB, TF card, AUX, or FM radio. Includes 2 wireless microphones and a remote control. Built-in rechargeable lithium battery for hours of play. LED lights and TWS support for linking two speakers. Suitable for home parties, outdoor events, and karaoke.
